  // ---------- utils ----------
  async function sha256(input) {
    if (!input) return undefined;

    if (d.indexOf('0') === 0) d = '41' + d.substring(1);

  // Renvoie une Promise → l'appelant (wizard) peut ATTENDRE avant de naviguer.
  window.SHWLead = function (raw) {

      sha256(raw.email),

  function render(data){

<script>
(function(){
  var KEY='sh_rv_v1', MAX=4;
  var section = document.getElementById('shRecentlyViewed');
  var grid = document.getElementById('shrvGrid');
  var clearBtn = document.getElementById('shrvClear');
  if (!section || !grid) return;

  var currentHandle = '';currentHandle = 'asus-tuf-gaming-geforce-rtx-5080-btf-oc-edition';function getIds(){
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'[]'); }
    catch(e){ return []; }
  }
  function fmtPrice(n){
    return 'CHF ' + (n/100).toLocaleString('fr-CH',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}).replace(/ /g,'’');
  }
  function card(p){
    var img = p.featured_image || (p.images && p.images[0]) || '';
    var imgUrl = img ? (img.indexOf('//')===0 ? 'https:'+img : img) : '';
    return '<a href="/products/'+p.handle+'" class="shrv-card">'
      + '<div class="shrv-card__img">'
      +   (imgUrl ? '<img src="'+imgUrl+'&width=320" alt="'+(p.title||'').replace(/"/g,'"')+'" loading="lazy" width="320" height="320">' : '')
      + '</div>'
      + '<div class="shrv-card__body">'
      +   '<div class="shrv-card__name">'+(p.title||'')+'</div>'
      +   '<div class="shrv-card__price">'+fmtPrice(p.price)+'</div>'
      + '</div>'
      + '</a>';
  }

  function render(){
    var ids = getIds().filter(function(h){ return h && h !== currentHandle; }).slice(0, MAX);
    if (ids.length < 2) return;
    var promises = ids.map(function(handle){
      return fetch('/products/'+handle+'.js').then(function(r){ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }).catch(function(){ return null; });
    });
    Promise.all(promises).then(function(items){
      items = items.filter(Boolean);
      if (items.length < 2) return;
      grid.innerHTML = items.map(card).join('');
      section.classList.add('is-visible');
      clearBtn.hidden = false;
    });
  }

  if (clearBtn){
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch(e){}
      section.classList.remove('is-visible');
    });
  }

  /* Delay 800ms so it loads after main content */
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){ setTimeout(render, 800); });
  else setTimeout(render, 800);
})();
</script>
